text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall despite several declines, which reinforces the value of patience over reacting to monthly swings.","I made no trades, so these results reflect holding through volatility; I should continue to trade only when a clear, plan-based reason arises.","A recent pullback after gains is a reminder to assess risk and diversification objectively, rather than being driven by loss aversion or the urge to lock in gains."]}
